absent-from-2014.flag: its whole text is not in the 2014 transcription
absent-from-2014.answer: 2014 line 14218 writes 'nonspace' for 2002's 'non-space': spelling only. Re-read §2002:13.16.24.2 GR3: unchanged.

definition-dropped.flag: character | in a coded character set (newer: undefined); character | in a screen item (newer: undefined); character | in cobol character repertoire (newer: undefined); character | in computer storage (newer: undefined); digit position (newer: undefined)
definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 4.27 'character (in a screen item)' and 4.63 digit position (storage/presentation sense) are the senses this screen rule uses; 2023 drops the character senses and adds a location sense of digit position. No program's scope changes: the FULL clause is a screen-section element, licensed non-support at 2002 and refused there (COBOL1560).

pending-clause.answer: Matched on 'normal termination key', the key that ends ACCEPT screen input, not run unit termination, initial state or transfer of control (§2002:14.5.2.1.2.1, 14.5.3, 14.5.10). The rule does not rest on those clauses.
